note: Palau issues no national identity card to its citizens: birth registration constitutes legal identity, and Palau has no digital ID for its citizens; its government-issued Palau ID is for digital residents under the Digital Residency Program (SEAP digital ID overview).

sources.title: Institute on Statelessness and Inclusion / SEAP, Digital ID overview: Palau
sources.said: Birth registration constitutes legal identity and authorities register births immediately. ... Palau does not have a digital ID system for its citizens, but is starting to develop one for non-citizens, if they wish to take up residency in Palau.
